scenarios.title: Render badge PDF generator form with interactive controls
given: an active event identifier exists in the system (e.g. EVENT101)
scenarios.when: the user navigates to the badge PDF generator page for that event
then: the badge generation form is displayed to the user
input controls for entering badge records are accessible
interactive controls for badge layout and formatting options are rendered and ready for user selection

scenarios.title: Access badge PDF generator form with non-existent event
given: an event identifier that does not exist in the system (e.g. UNKNOWN999)
scenarios.when: the user attempts to access the badge PDF generator page for that event identifier
then: an error notification is displayed stating that the event cannot be found
the badge generation form is not made available for badge generation

scenarios.title: Generate badge PDF with valid badge data and default options
given: the user is on the badge PDF generator form for a valid event
valid badge recipient data is provided
scenarios.when: the user submits the form to generate the badges
then: the user receives a valid generated PDF document containing the submitted badge data

scenarios.title: Generate badge PDF preserving customized form options
given: the user is on the badge PDF generator form for a valid event
the user has selected specific custom form options (e.g. badge layout, print dimensions, or style options)
valid badge recipient data is entered
scenarios.when: the user submits the form to generate the badges
then: the user receives a valid generated PDF document
the output PDF document reflects the chosen configuration and formatting options

scenarios.title: Reject PDF generation when required badge data is missing
given: the user is on the badge PDF generator form
scenarios.when: the user submits the form without providing required badge data
then: a validation error message informing the user that required badge data is missing is displayed

scenarios.title: Reject PDF generation when badge data format is invalid
given: the user is on the badge PDF generator form
the badge input contains malformed or unparseable data
scenarios.when: the user submits the form to generate the badges
then: a validation error message indicating the badge data is invalid or improperly formatted is displayed
